entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: Success means an imported pattern/intent library preserves exact source identity, provenance, applicability boundaries, counterexamples, evidence/trust state, and immutable source payload; every import remains candidate-only and non-authoritative; any attempt to activate, silently alter, omit required source context, or treat imported instructions as executable is rejected by retained verifier fixtures.
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: The roadmap item is valid, but it is narrowed to safe import and auditability; local applicability and reproduction remain v0.8.2 so v0.8.1 cannot overclaim reuse.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: Imported knowledge has not been tested against target-specific cases, loss boundaries, stakeholder context, or unseen counterexamples, so local applicability and reproduction remain unestablished.
entries.expectation_state: Portable quality-knowledge policies, exact source snapshots, canonical digests, provenance, applicability boundaries, counterexamples, trust metadata, candidate-only decisions, governance, documentation, retained fixtures, and portable validation are complete; committed evidence remains example-only and insufficient.
entries.mismatch_state: Imported knowledge has not been tested against target-specific cases, loss boundaries, stakeholder context, or unseen counterexamples, so local applicability and reproduction remain unestablished.
entries.scale_direction: Implement v0.8.2 Local Applicability and Reproduction with target-specific cases, applicability decisions, reproduction evidence, activation gates, and governed rejection.
